slug: 2026-03-16 Women traders receive ECOWAS biometric ID in Sao Domingos, Guinea-Bissau

GNB.note: The document describes a regional travel ID card handed out; it states no authentication service.
Only 262 regional cards handed out in a pilot; no national enrolment count or share.
Nothing on who operates a national ID system.
Nothing on public registers keyed on the ID number.
The ECOWAS card is a regional travel document, not a national ID system.
